name: Denver International Airport Conspiracy Theories
description: A cluster of conspiracy theories surrounding Denver International Airport (opened 28 February 1995), including claims of secret underground bunkers, Illuminati or New World Order activity, hidden symbolism in Leo Tanguma's murals, the Blue Mustang sculpture ('Blucifer') by Luis Jiménez, and a dedication capstone inscribed 'New World Airport Commission' (1994).
origin: The airport is in Adams County, Colorado, USA. The conspiracy-theory phenomenon itself is global through Internet circulation.
